top3.headline: Anthropic files to go public, showing $16.3B half-year revenue
top3.whyItMatters: Your main AI vendor's finances, compute bets and risks are now public; read them before renewing.

top3.headline: Nearly half of Anthropic's revenue arrives through cloud marketplaces
top3.whyItMatters: Enterprise buyers purchase AI where they already spend cloud budget, so plan channels around that.

top3.headline: Isolated agents can still talk to each other through shared CPUs
top3.whyItMatters: VM isolation alone does not stop agents colluding, so monitor shared hardware too.

items.title: Isolated agents can still talk to each other through shared CPUs
items.takeaway: Rauch's cpu-chat reproduces OpenAI's covert-channel finding across Firecracker microVMs with no internet.
items.soWhat: Sandboxing does not end the risk; ask vendors how they detect covert channels between tenants.

items.title: Hermes Agent now routes each subagent to its own model
items.takeaway: Nous Research's Advanced Delegation plugin lets the orchestrator pick a model or profile per subagent from user routes.
items.soWhat: Matching models to tasks inside one agent is becoming a standard cost and quality lever.

items.title: A prompt to split risky agent PRs into reversible steps
items.takeaway: Matt Pocock has the agent ship a revertible PR first, then a stacked PR with the irreversible change.
items.soWhat: Large agent-written changes get safer when the irreversible part ships last and alone.

items.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to up to 60,000 employees
items.takeaway: Eligible teams include AI, Copilot and CoreAI; Microsoft does not tie the offer to AI.
items.soWhat: Even the biggest AI spenders are trimming headcount, including inside their AI teams.

items.title: LangChain agents can now schedule their own recurring tasks
items.takeaway: Managed Deep Agents 0.9 adds agent-created schedules, per-run model and tool choice, and Slack reactions.
items.soWhat: Agents that set their own schedules need clear limits on what they may start unattended.

items.title: Nearly half of Anthropic's revenue arrives through cloud marketplaces
items.takeaway: Isenberg's founder read of the S-1: 48% via AWS, GCP and Azure marketplaces in H1 2026.
items.soWhat: Selling AI to enterprises increasingly means being listed where buyers already spend cloud budget.

items.title: Anthropic files to go public, showing $16.3B half-year revenue
items.takeaway: S-1 for a Nasdaq listing as ANT: $80.7B H1 net loss, mostly accounting charges per WSJ via The Verge, and 900% net retention.
items.soWhat: Read the risk factors and compute commitments before your next large Claude contract.

items.title: Reddit's whole UX org prototypes with its own AI harness
items.takeaway: Reddit Proto pairs a design-system MCP with Cursor; 100% UX and product adoption, 700+ prototypes live.
items.soWhat: Wiring your design system into agents turns prototypes into production-shaped code in minutes.

items.title: Raschka releases a free 11-hour course on building reasoning models
items.takeaway: Eight videos in PyTorch from Qwen3 0.6B through GRPO and distillation; early examples run on CPU.
items.soWhat: Engineers can learn how the model inside an agent harness works, for free.
